mainline: DNA and species → multi-scale backbone → one-dimensional tracks and two-dimensional contacts

conventions.recurrence_evidence: HyenaDNA full operator SVG nests three meaningful functional groups and uses a single vertical primary chain with local skip branches. DNABERT-2 tokenizer SVG is a representation detail, not a full architecture.
conventions.methodology_relevance: Partial: retain purposeful nested model grouping and separate input representation; AlphaGenome directed science comes from its own method.
conventions.visual_treatment: Three purposeful macro regions with native internal modules; do not reuse Hyena gating.

conventions.recurrence_evidence: DNABERT-2 SVG visibly writes A/C/G/T nucleotide strings, aligned colored substrings and token rows. HyenaDNA SVG instead shows abstract x input/output, with no measured genomic trace.
conventions.methodology_relevance: Essential input need only: use our short ACGT row and one-hot cells; do not import BPE or claim the peer supports genomic output traces.
conventions.visual_treatment: Native nucleotide strip and tiny one-hot array; our outputs remain source-grounded symbolic tracks.

conventions.recurrence_evidence: HyenaDNA uses repeated long-convolution/gate blocks and explicit additive residual blocks; DNABERT shows overlapping vs non-overlapping tokenization.
conventions.methodology_relevance: Non-essential: reject Hyena operators, add/gate symbols and BPE because this AlphaGenome overview does not rely on them. Essential U-Net skips and 1D/2D branches come from the AlphaGenome method text.
conventions.visual_treatment: Source-checked U-Net abstract levels with skips; no transplanted residual gate topology.

conventions.recurrence_evidence: HyenaDNA separates block/operator/filter subfigures with nested outline density. DNABERT aligns sequence examples in two comparison groups with generous surrounding white.
conventions.methodology_relevance: Partial: a locally detailed backbone and coarse input/readouts fit; no comparison panel or extra model.
conventions.visual_treatment: Keep supporting readouts compact and emphasize high-resolution plus pair-representation branching.

source_gaps: No genuine SVG located for original AlphaGenome or Borzoi architecture; no previous PNG/PDF image is reused. HyenaDNA is an internal module figure and DNABERT-2 is a tokenizer detail, not two complete sequence-to-function architectures.
